tool_calls.purpose: Inspect the approved v2 art package, existing v1 scene integration, implementation/QA profiles, and repository execution rules before editing.
outputs: A bounded visual-only integration plan with separate WP-040 and WP-041 contracts.
evidence: BK approved all seven direct_art_v2 roles for prototype integration planning.
player.gd binds to gameplay Area2D, collision, HUD, and retry nodes rather than specific art resources, allowing a scene-resource-only visual swap.

tool_calls.purpose: Replace the scene's v1 art references with all seven approved v2 assets while preserving gameplay nodes, collision resources, labels, and script behavior.
evidence: The scene now references exactly the seven direct_art_v2 textures and no v1 direct-art texture.
SectionOneBackdrop and SectionTwoBackdrop were replaced by one full-world BackgroundWorldLayer plus one uniform readability wash.
AtlasTexture crops use the validated alpha bounds for player, platform, item, hazard, goal, and HUD assets.
Ground, WarmupStep, Platform, HazardArea, CollectibleArea, GoalArea, Player, Camera2D, HUD, and RetryButton remain present.

tool_calls.purpose: Verify import stability, smoke startup, clean headless runtime, and actual rendered scene composition.
evidence: Godot 4.6.3 imported and loaded the scene without script, resource, parse, or runtime errors.
A macOS OpenGL Movie Maker frame shows the left/start view with player, platforms, HUD, and low-priority background.
A temporary external capture script shows the right view with hazard, item, player, goal, platform, HUD, and background visibly separated.

commands.notes: WP-040 validates; the repository's expected missing date-format plugin warning is informational.

commands.command: Static v2 reference, no-v1, single-background, gameplay-node, and protected-file checks
commands.notes: All seven v2 resources are referenced, no v1 art remains, exactly one BackgroundWorldLayer exists, gameplay/collision nodes remain, and player.gd/project.godot are unchanged.
Smoke test passed with no SCRIPT ERROR or ERROR output.

commands.command: godot --headless --path game --scene res://scenes/main.tscn --quit-after 3 with clean-output guard

commands.notes: Godot 4.6.3 headless Movie Maker crashed in the dummy renderer at texture_2d_get. This is a capture-path engine failure, not a game runtime failure; ordinary headless import/smoke/runtime remained green.
Recovered visual capture through the macOS OpenGL renderer and produced two PNG frames.
Temporary non-repository capture script produced a right-side integration frame for visual inspection.

notes: WP-040 completed as a scene-resource-only playable-art integration. The approved v2 player, goal, hazard, item, platform, HUD, and single Background World Layer are now used by the scene. The background remains visual-only, labels remain secondary aids, and the original collision/gameplay nodes and player.gd behavior are unchanged. Rendered left and right views show the intended hierarchy and silhouette separation at the configured scene scale. This implementation does not self-approve QA, production usage, final art direction, push, merge, or deployment; it hands off to WP-041.
